primary_abstraction: PAINT = Composition × Surface × Pattern × Meaning × Transformation
laws: BYTE IDENTITY != AESTHETIC FINGERPRINT != COMPOSITION CLASS != SEMANTIC MEANING
COMPOSITION CONTROL AND STYLE CONTROL REMAIN SEPARATE
STRUCTURE-SENSITIVE WORK GETS PROCEDURAL/VECTOR/DEPTH/MASK SCAFFOLDS BEFORE RENDERING
RENDER BACKENDS ARE ADAPTERS, NOT THE COMPILER
NO SWEEP WITHOUT HYPOTHESIS + BUDGET + STOP CONDITION
SELECTED SOURCE -> RECIPE -> RESULT RETAINS LINEAGE; BULK MEDIA STAYS OUT OF REPO
EXPORT SHARE FOR HUMANS; EXPORT MEMORY FOR RECONSTRUCTION

PAINT.authority: binds five explicit axes without hiding locks

TRANSLATE.authority: translation only; cannot rewrite recipe intent

MOVE.authority: motion only unless recipe explicitly unlocks another axis

recipe_contract.lock_law: Every controlled variation declares exactly which axes may change. Unlisted axes are locked by source lineage.
recipe_contract.budget_law: Budget counts rendered outputs, not prompt attempts. A failed structural lock consumes evidence and can trigger stop.
recipe_contract.stop_law: Stop when the hypothesis is answered, the budget is exhausted, or a locked axis drifts materially. Do not compensate by opening more axes.

storage.repo: scripts + contracts + compact fingerprints/receipts + selected recipes only
storage.external_or_local: source media, contact sheets, masks/control maps, render outputs unless intentionally promoted
storage.lineage_key: sha256 for byte identity + explicit source receipt + recipe id + backend result id/hash

automation_v0_1.resume_key: relative_path + bytes + mtime_ns; exact SHA remains byte identity
automation_v0_1.semantic_loop: worker-packets.jsonl -> memory/semantic-overlays/<batch>.json -> rerun -> reviewed C/A/P/M recipe candidates
automation_v0_1.render_boundary: generation=false; recipes remain backend UNBOUND until TRANSLATE
automation_v0_1.heavy_output_boundary: contact sheets, maps and bulk media stay local/external by default

semantic_supervisor.authority: semantic overlay + validation only; no source mutation or rendering
